description.narrative: Stöd till UN Action Against Sexual Violence in Conflict och Team of Experts för arbete inom FN-systemet med att förebygga sexuellt våld i konflikt.
Support to UN Action Against Sexual Violence in Conflict and Team of Experts for their work within the UN-System to prevent sexual violence in conflict.

General question: Results related to the intended outcome 2014Question: Summarise results related to the intended outcome (this information will be sent to Open Aid)Answer: The support from the UN Action secretariat has enabled UN entities to advance their efforts of delivering "as one" in response to the challenges posed by Conflict-Related Sexual Violence (CRSV). UN Action has also supported and funded the deployment of Women Protection Advisers and supported national strategies to address the issue. The support by the Team of Experts to national governments has contributed to a rule of law response to address CRSV in a number of countries, which can be measured in some cases by an increase in the number of investigations and/ or prosecutions carried out in these countries or in new law or guidelines promulgated.
No indicator available - only a description of the activity results is published
